overview: Katta Upper is the elevated civic district of Katta Castellum, representing Loyalist stability and Senate governance.
history: Constructed as the administrative terrace after the Loyalist schism.
Designed to oversee the lower wards and maintain civic order.
Arcane stabilizers were installed to maintain magical harmony across the city.
The district houses mid‑tier Senate offices and civic registrars.
hooks: A Senate registrar requests assistance with census anomalies.
Arcane stabilizers pulse irregularly, drawing attention.
A Loyalist envoy arrives from the Arcane Quarter.
A disturbance in the lower wards echoes into the terraces.
